map: 7.2 only: it replaced the Demon Legs Quest on Fibula (user 2026-11-25; the wiki says 6.4 for real Tibia). Positions from the 7.2 map: switches 33190/33191,31629,13 (stone tiles), Gate of the Lost Souls 33211,31630,13, key 6010 door 33211,31634,13, gate of expertise 33211,31638,13, portal 33278,31592,11 -> 33279,31592,12, hole 33293,31592,12 (down two floors), portal 33324,31592,14 -> the quest room 33324,31592,15 (chests 33313,31591-31593,15, exit lever 33330,31591,15).

newQuest.rewards: Demon Helmet, Demon Shield, Steel Boots
newQuest.wiki_reward: Demon Helmet, Demon Shield and Steel Boots (later also the Demon Outfits' first addon)

steps.text: Level 100. Bring a team for at least 9 demons (5 on the way, 4 in the quest room, maybe a respawn on the way back), lots of banshees and fire elementals. Even solo you need two more players to stand on the switches. You need the golden key 6010 from the Parchment Room Quest.
steps.source: You will need a team capable of facing a total of at least 9 demons (5 on the way, 4 in the quest room, and a possible respawn on the way back) and a large number of banshees. ... you will still need two other players, namely to stand on the switches. You will need a golden Key 6010 ... obtainable through the Parchment Room Quest.
Enter the Edron Hero Cave (Mapper Coords 129.140, 123.150, 7)

steps.text: Head down through the Hero Cave to the level 100 gate of expertise, near the single demon.
steps.source: head down until you get to the level 100 gate of expertise near the single demon spawn

steps.text: Open the door behind the gate of expertise with the golden key 6010.
steps.source: You will need a golden Key 6010 to open the door after the gate of expertise.

steps.text: Two players stand on the two switches to the west. That opens the Gate of the Lost Souls.
steps.source: Have two players stand on the switches (Mapper Coords 129.167, 123.141, 13) to get past the Gate of the Lost Souls (129.187, 123.142, 13).

steps.text: Through the Gate of the Lost Souls: kill the fire elementals.
steps.source: Once you kill all the Fire Elementals, head down the passage

steps.text: Follow the passage (only one way; lots of fire on the floor) to the portal.
steps.source: head down the passage until you come to a portal (there's only one way to go). Note that there is a lot of fire on the way there

steps.text: Behind the portal: kill the demon.
steps.source: When you get to the portal, go through it. There will be one demon here. Kill the demon

steps.text: Go through the hole: it drops you two floors down.
steps.source: and head through the hole here. This will bring you down 2 floors to the cave where the portal into the quest room is.

steps.text: Head east and kill everything: 2 demons where you land, then one demon in each room, plus fire elementals.
steps.source: There are 4 demons and a couple Fire Elementals here, but they don't all come at once (There'll be 2 demons where you enter and if you head east there's one demon in each room). Head east and kill all the creatures.

steps.text: The portal at the east end takes you to the quest room right below.
steps.source: Here you will see a portal that brings you to the quest room. The portal will bring you to a room right below you

steps.text: Pull the lever on the east side first: it opens the portal out, in case someone has to flee.
steps.source: Note that there is a switch (#2) on the east side of the room that must be pulled to activate the portal to get out. It is recommended that you do this before you kill anything

steps.text: Kill the 4 demons and the banshees in the quest room.
steps.source: The portal will bring you to a room right below you with 4 demons and a lot of banshees.

steps.text: The three chests on the west side: Demon Helmet, Demon Shield and Steel Boots. Then leave through the portal; demons may have respawned on the way out.
steps.source: The boxes containing the rewards are on the west side of the room (#1). Once you have killed the creatures and got your reward, go out through the portal. Be careful of demons that may have respawned on the way out.
